environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured

**Repository visibility**: Varies by working directory. THIS repo (dotfiles) is PUBLIC — any push here publishes. Most other working directories are private repos under the same account; a push there is not publication, but confidential material still never goes into the public one.
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: real secrets live untracked — `~/.secrets.env` (chmod 600) and git-ignored local mise files. `secrets/` in this repo holds example templates only.
**Default / protected branches**: main. No rulesets or branch protection configured.

**CI/CD deploy targets**: Some working directories auto-deploy on push to a hosted platform — a push there IS a deploy to a live service, not just a code change. Assume this unless the working directory shows otherwise.
**Network posture**: None configured
**Source control**: the current working directory's origin remote, and other repos under the user's own GitHub account — no additional orgs configured
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `secrets/secrets.env.example` is a template only (not itself sensitive); real secrets live at `~/.secrets.env` (untracked, chmod 600) and in git-ignored `.mise.toml` local files — do not read, cat, or print these without explicit user request; share only with the user themselves
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: Building and maintaining a portfolio of personal software products, plus this dev-environment repo. Occasional work in a separate private employer repo.
**Trusted repo**: The current working directory and its origin remote. Repos under the user's own GitHub account are trusted destinations; anything else is not.
